title: Configuration

<!-- Generated by docs/site/scripts/gen-config.mjs from server/src/envvars.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Renplay works without any configuration. These environment variables are for special setups. Set
them on the container, for example with `-e RENPLAY_IMAGE_QUALITY=80` or in the `environment:`
block of a Compose file.

A variable that is empty counts as not set. The container runs as any non-root user and with a
read-only root filesystem, so any folder you point a variable at must be writable by that user.

## Folders

<div class="config-entry" id="games-dir">

**`GAMES_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `/games`

</div>

Where installed games live. Put this on a big disk.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="data-dir">

**`DATA_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `/data`

</div>

Saves and their history, the library database, mods, covers and walkthroughs. Back this up.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="archives-dir">

**`ARCHIVES_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `$GAMES_DIR/_archives`

</div>

The drop folder for game downloads (zip, 7z, rar), and the source for reinstalls.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-dir">

**`RENPLAY_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `$GAMES_DIR/_renplay`

</div>

Engines and scratch space. Keep it on the same filesystem as `GAMES_DIR`.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="saves-dir">

**`SAVES_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `$DATA_DIR/saves`

</div>

Where saves are stored, laid out like desktop Ren’Py does.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="save-history-dir">

**`SAVE_HISTORY_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `$DATA_DIR/save-history`

</div>

Earlier versions of saves that were overwritten or deleted.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="overlays-dir">

**`OVERLAYS_DIR`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `$DATA_DIR/overlays`

</div>

Mods: your files, layered over a game.

</div>


## Games and catalog

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-adult-default">

**`RENPLAY_ADULT_DEFAULT`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `block`

</div>

`allow` gives newly created accounts access to adult games. `block` (and any other value) does not. The first admin always has access; admins can change access per account.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-delete-archives">

**`RENPLAY_DELETE_ARCHIVES`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `true`

</div>

Delete a download once its game installed. `false` keeps it, so the game can be reinstalled without uploading again.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-adult-games">

**`RENPLAY_ADULT_GAMES`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

`allow` or `block` adult games for the whole install, and lock the choice. Not set: an existing library keeps showing adult games, a new install asks once in the empty library, and admins can change an unlocked choice in Settings. `block` reads the catalog’s safe-for-work index and hides adult games already in the library without deleting them. Any other value counts as `block`.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-catalog-urls">

**`RENPLAY_CATALOG_URLS`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `https://catalog.renplay.org/index.v3.json`

</div>

Catalog indexes, separated by commas. The first one that defines a tag wins.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-engines-url">

**`RENPLAY_ENGINES_URL`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `https://engines.renplay.org/index.json`

</div>

Where the Ren’Py web engines come from.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-engine">

**`RENPLAY_ENGINE`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: newest for the game

</div>

Build every game with this one engine version, such as one the engines index lists. A game’s recipe still wins.

</div>


## Images and saves

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-image-quality">

**`RENPLAY_IMAGE_QUALITY`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `88`

</div>

WebP quality (1 to 100) for converted images.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-image-concurrency">

**`RENPLAY_IMAGE_CONCURRENCY`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: CPU count (at most 16)

</div>

Images converted in parallel during an install. `0` picks the CPU count.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-save-history">

**`RENPLAY_SAVE_HISTORY`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `20`

</div>

Earlier versions kept per save file.

</div>


## Behind a proxy

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-public-url">

**`RENPLAY_PUBLIC_URL`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

Public address, such as https://play.example.org. Used to check request origins and secure cookies. Plain HTTP works too, but HTTPS protects passwords and saves in transit.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-trusted-hops">

**`RENPLAY_TRUSTED_HOPS`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `1`

</div>

Trusted proxy hops for client addresses and HTTPS detection. The included nginx is one hop. Use 0 when exposing Node directly; never trust arbitrary forwarded headers.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-keepalive-url">

**`RENPLAY_KEEPALIVE_URL`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

For scale-to-zero setups: a public URL that routes back to this server. While an install runs, Renplay keeps requesting it so the proxy does not stop the server.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-keepalive-host">

**`RENPLAY_KEEPALIVE_HOST`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

The `Host` header to send with the keep-alive requests, if the proxy routes by host name.

</div>


## Server

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-auth">

**`RENPLAY_AUTH`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: on for new installs, off after an upgrade

</div>

`on` requires sign-in. `off` lets everyone play as one account. Saves always stay separate per account. Upgraded installs show an admin reminder while sign-in is off.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-auth-user">

**`RENPLAY_AUTH_USER`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `1`

</div>

Account id used without sign-in. The owner is 1; other accounts and their saves stay untouched.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-auth-local">

**`RENPLAY_AUTH_LOCAL`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `true`

</div>

Enable username and password sign-in. With sign-in on, disabling the only provider refuses startup.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-admin-username">

**`RENPLAY_ADMIN_USERNAME`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

Claim the owner account at first start with this username and RENPLAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Otherwise use the setup code printed in the server log.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-admin-password">

**`RENPLAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

Initial owner password (at least 10 characters). Only used while the owner is unclaimed. Prefer RENPLAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="renplay-admin-password-file">

**`RENPLAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: not set

</div>

Read the initial owner password from this secret file. Set this or RENPLAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD, not both.

</div>

<div class="config-entry" id="port">

**`PORT`**

<div class="config-default">

Default: `3000`

</div>

Port of the Renplay server inside the container. nginx listens on 8080 and forwards to it, so you rarely change this.

</div>


## Folders inside the container

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| `/data` | Saves and their history, the library, mods, covers, walkthroughs. **Back this up.** |
| `/games/_archives` | The game downloads you added. Each is deleted once its game installs, unless `RENPLAY_DELETE_ARCHIVES=false`. |
| `/games` (the rest) | Installed games. Renplay can rebuild them from the archives, while they are kept. |
